_comment: Director-funded recurring expenses paid on Umar's personal card and reimbursable by the corporation. Edit this file to add, change or stop an item, then re-run scripts/expand_recurring_expenses.py. 'claim_pct' is the business share. 'hst_status' drives whether an ITC arises: 'taxable' = HST is in the price and claimable, 'exempt' = no HST charged (insurance and residential rent are exempt supplies), 'zero_rated' = HST at 0%.

items.name: Home insurance
items.note: Claimed in full. Insurance is an exempt financial service, so no HST and no ITC.

items.name: Phone and internet
items.note: Modelled only after the last known actual (Bell, Sep 13, 2026). Earlier months come from personal_actuals.csv (Bell payments, Rogers bills). Rogers ended Apr 2026; Bell bundle is $113/month.

items.name: Rent — home office share
items.note: Full rent recorded; 30% is the business share, matching the rate used on the filed 2025 T2. Residential rent is an exempt supply, so no ITC.
